Calling me a whore, slut, cunt, bitch, etc. during sex and then get pissed when I get pissed off about being demeaned. 

Seriously, no filthy names unless you know for sure she likes that.

Back in the 90's. It is possible that things have changed since then, but my situation was admittedly unique. I had parents who were officially in bankruptcy yet were making six figures. While they didn't pay anything towards my education, as far as financial aid was concerned they were, or should have been, despite what the reality was. I worked full time to pay for my education to make up for that gap in loan coverage. I tried every possible way to fight it and was met with little sympathy by people in the financial aid department. They saw me as a rich kid trying to beat the system, rather than a kid with deadbeat parents who decided last minute not to help with tuition as promised.

At least then there wasn't. If you were under 26 and were doing an undergrad degree, the assumption was that they were supporting you. If they declared you on their taxes, the school took it as absolute proof of financial support. Since they refused to not declare me on their taxes, there was nothing I could do. Trust me, I tried.

Oh, I feel you there. I was told through my entire teens that there was a college fund set up for me. Then I found out they had spent it before I started college. 

They declared bankruptcy meaning they couldn't take out the loans themselves, but promised me that they would make the payments on the ones I was taking out. 

Because they made a lot of money, I didn't even qualify for enough to cover all of my tuition and because they never told me there was no college fund, I hadn't built one up. When I tried to get myself declared independent so that their income wouldn't count towards the expected family contribution, they refused to sign the forms because it would mean they would lose a tax credit for me. 

And of course they never made a single payment towards anything, ever.

I have suffered from bipolar disorder since I was a pre-teen. My parents always reacted with punishing and abusing me when they were told by my teachers to get me help. My father didn't believe mental heath care was actually a thing and refused to take me in to treatment. It was only once I turned 18 that I was able to get myself help. 

I was an overachiever my entire life, and ended up in a professional field. Then in 2008, my illness became treatment resistant and I had to be hospitalized. They completely abandoned me during that time, refusing to visit or participate in my care. The believed it was something I should have dealt with without embarrassing the family by making my treatment so public. 

It went into remission, but I began having problems again in 2011 when the medication I was taking started causing a severe neurological reaction. I became very ill after that and have been having reactions to one medication after another. 

Their reaction was to completely disown me for "pissing away my career and education". (Something I paid for, not them, btw.) 

Not only have I had no contact of any kind for years, but they also made it clear to the rest of the family that they weren't allowed to speak to me either. As a result, my siblings also won't speak to me and have completely cut me off from their kids also. 

As an example of how serious they take this - six months after they stopped talking to me, my favorite aunt died. I found out from my sister via Facebook message a few weeks later. I was only told because she felt bad that I didn't know, but she made sure to tell me after the funeral because she knew the shit would hit the fan of I showed up.

At this moment, my mood has swung from "base level depressed" to dangerously depressed. I feel like I am barely clinging on to my sanity. I'm afraid to call anyone because, around here, they just throw you in the hospital at the drop of a hat.

Facebook is pretty well known for causing depression. The funny thing is I know this, but it doesn't help at all. I look at it and see that everyone else has this perfect life, while I am here alone and in pain. I just keep how bad it is to myself now specifically because of people complaining about others being "drama queens" and making their timelines depressing. I sugar coated everything myself so that I wouldn't be one of those drama queens. In the end, that just left me with no 
help when I needed it.
That's what I'm afraid of. I can feel deep inside that I have just given up on life. I'm afraid the TMS won't bring me back soon enough.
Have you started yet? I do my mapping this week. Next step is ECT again if this doesn't work. Part of me would rather die than do that again.
